name: COURIER
description: An unidentified messenger in an orange rain cape who delivers cryptic instructions at the ferry ticket office. Appears only as a silhouette through frosted glass, speaking briefly and departing without revealing their identity or purpose.

explicit_evidence.quote: Seventeen. North locker. Before the tide turns.

inferred_traits.rationale: The instruction 'Before the tide turns' suggests time-sensitive delivery and implies knowledge of local tidal conditions.
Refuses to answer who sent them and retreats without further engagement, suggesting deliberate concealment of identity.

dialogue_summary: Delivers a single line of instruction: 'Seventeen. North locker. Before the tide turns.' Refuses to identify who sent them.

relationships.evidence: Courier delivers instructions to Lena at the ticket office regarding locker 17.
